messages:
Leah (Partnerships): morning team  we have a new SI that wants to be listed in the cloud marketplaces and do a joint hardware partner pilot. want to align onboarding + a joint announce timeline. high level: 6-week enablement, marketplace listing checklist, and a co-announcement with HW vendor.
Marco (SI Enablement): sounds good. I'd split enablement into: preboarding (docs + creds), 1-week core workshop, 2-week lab pilot with HW integration, and a certification run. keep the marketplace checklist separate since that has legal/marketing steps.
Tara (Marketing): for co-announcement we need 1) partner quote, 2) partner-approved logo, 3) joint architecture diagram, 4) launch one-pager. timeline: need assets 10 business days pre-announce.
Diego (Solutions Eng): technical ask: the HW partner wants to validate quantized inference on their A100 blades and run the sample inference at 2 batch sizes. need to coordinate bench env and firmware version.
Sam (Sales): commercial side: partner wants referral credit for marketplace deals and a 60-day pilot discount. I'll draft a merchant listing addendum and pilot pricing.
Ruth (Legal): flag: marketplace listings require our standard partner terms + export compliance check for the HW country of origin. also for co-announcements we need to sign an NDA if there's pre-release IP.
Marco (SI Enablement): ops items: can we provision an "SI-hw-test" sandbox with limited GPU nodes? Diego, what metrics do you need captured?
Diego (Solutions Eng): capture p50/p90 latency, throughput (tokens/s), GPU memory usage, and a small quality check (5 sample prompts). also record model variant + quantization bits.
Leah (Partnerships): marketplace checklist idea (short): partner profile, co-marketing opt-in, listing assets (logo, description), pricing bucket, support SLAs, integration docs, and legal sign-off.
Tara (Marketing): add: required hero image (1200x600), a short 40-word blurb, and a link to the pilot case study landing page (post-launch).
Sam (Sales): I'll coordinate the referral language and pricing band. need to know if pilot includes Dedicated or Private deployment.
Marco (SI Enablement): recommend pilot on Dedicated capacity to mirror production for customers; Private is heavier legally.
Ruth (Legal): agree. for Dedicated we still need data handling language clarified. I'll send a short checklist for marketplace legal items.
Leah (Partnerships): announcement cadence proposal: week 0 = internal kickoff, week 2 = marketing draft & bench validation, week 4 = pilot sign-off & legal ok, week 6 = public co-announcement.
Diego (Solutions Eng): one more tech note: require SSH access to the HW management plane for debugging. This may need the HW partner's approval.
Tara (Marketing): can we run a small partner webinar 3 days after the announce to drive leads? sets expectations for comms.
Sam (Sales): webinar great. sales can host an invite list and seed top accounts.
Marco (SI Enablement): certification criteria for SI: pass bench (>= target throughput), complete a runbook PR, and complete 1 trainer-shadow session. then we issue badge and marketplace "verified SI" tag.
Ruth (Legal): ensure runbook IP assignment is covered in CLA. also confirm that the partner-run webinar slides exclude customer data.
announce-bot: reminder set: 1955558000 -> "SI x HW co-announcement dry run"
Leah (Partnerships): action items: Marco = enablement schedule & cert rubric; Diego = bench script + metrics; Sam = pricing & marketplace commercial terms; Tara = creative brief and webinar plan; Ruth = marketplace legal checklist. I'll schedule the kickoff invite for Wed 9am PT. :calendar:
